FLIGHT PROCEDURES - ADD NEW SECTION 'COMMUNICATIONS AND SSR'
A. AIRCRAFT IN COMMUNICATION WITH WEST WALES ATS MAY BE ALLOCATED A
CONSPICUITY SQUAWK OF 4527. AIRCRAFT MUST NOT SELECT THIS SQUAWK
UNLESS INSTRUCTED TO DO SO BY ATS.
B. AIRCRAFT REMAINING IN THE CIRCUIT AT WEST WALES WILL BE
ALLOCATED A CONSPICUITY SQUAWK OF 7010. AIRCRAFT MUST NOT SELECT
THIS SQUAWK UNLESS INSTRUCTED TO DO SO BY ATS.
C. ALLOCATION OF THESE CONSPICUITY SQUAWKS DOES NOT CONSTITUTE ANY
RADAR SERVICE.
UK AIP EGFA AD 2.22 REFERS.
